keyPoints.en: Singular: is, was, has, verb + s
keyPoints.hi: एकवचन: is, was, has, verb + s

keyPoints.en: Plural: are, were, have, verb (no s)
keyPoints.hi: बहुवचन: are, were, have, verb (बिना s)

keyPoints.en: Each, every, everyone take a singular verb.
keyPoints.hi: Each, every, everyone के साथ एकवचन क्रिया।

problem.en: Choose: "The box of pencils (is/are) on the desk."
problem.hi: चुनो: "The box of pencils (is/are) on the desk."

intro.en: The verb must agree with its subject. A singular subject takes a singular verb (The boy runs); a plural subject takes a plural verb (The boys run).
intro.hi: क्रिया अपने कर्ता से मेल खानी चाहिए। एकवचन कर्ता के साथ एकवचन क्रिया (The boy runs); बहुवचन कर्ता के साथ बहुवचन क्रिया (The boys run)।
